briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 escalate multi-agent race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Global AI funding surges past $14B this quarter as nations prioritize compute sovereignty.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with advanced agentic capabilities; xAI releases Grok-3; DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-4o performance at lower cost. Meta open-sources Llama-4-405B sparking industry debate.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement targets agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 2nm AI chips for NVIDIA; Microsoft announces $40B hyperscale expansion in Europe and Asia.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols become the decisive bottleneck before AGI arrives?
